item.title: visualstudio: Announcing Visual Studio 2026 LTSC 18.11
item.description:
Microsoft announced Visual Studio 2026 LTSC 18.11, released alongside Visual Studio 2026 18.12 on the Stable channel. LTSC 18.11 will now receive two years of support, through November 14, 2028, instead of the one year previously announced.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: dotnet: Announcing .NET 11
item.description:
The post announces .NET 11 and mentions C# 15, faster developer tools, runtime and library improvements, and new capabilities for web, mobile, desktop, and AI apps.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: github: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna now available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot now includes two additional OpenAI GPT-6 models: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. They join the previously available GPT-6 Astra as selectable model options.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is generally available. The release adds new platform capabilities, including administrator configuration for Copilot CLI.

  • Source: GitHub
